I t was an evening of worship, music and heartfelt tributes as businessman Brown Kabiti celebrated his 50th birthday. The all-white concert brought together family members, friends and prominent personalities in Lagos State. Tagged, ‘Songs and Stories of Brown Kabiti at 50’, the gathering, held at the RCCG Redemption Pavilion, Plot 295, Jide Oki Street, Victoria Island, Lagos, on Saturday, October 24, was designed as a thanksgiving for five decades of life, faith and God’s faithfulness. Among the notable guests spotted at the celebration were industrialist and socialite, Chief Mrs Shade Okoya, and Raheem Okoya, whose presence added glamour to the gathering. The celebrant’s wife, Morayo Afolabi-Brown, was also a central figure at the occasion. Make PUNCH part of your everyday experience. Add us to your Preferred Sources One of the standout moments came when Brown took the microphone to shower his wife with praises and heartfelt appreciation, publicly acknowledging her place in his life. Okoya’s estranged son still receives support — Family Union marks golden jubilee Woman remanded over alleged cyberstalking of Shade Okoya The emotional tribute added a personal touch to the celebration, which was not just about marking a golden jubilee but also recognising the people who had contributed to the celebrant’s journey. Before taking the stage for the musical performance, Brown also shared the inspiration behind the gathering, explaining the significance of bringing people together through songs, stories and worship. The concert featured moments of praise, worship, musical performances and thanksgiving, with guests dressed in white to reflect the celebratory theme. Brown’s golden jubilee celebration also attracted attention online, with videos and photographs capturing the worship sessions, the couple’s affectionate moments and the gathering of guests. For the celebrant, the occasion was evidently more than a birthday party. It was a moment to reflect on five decades of life, acknowledge God’s blessings and celebrate the relationships that have shaped his journey. Kindly share this story:
